hero.title: An agent-native knowledge base
hero.lede: knloop explores what knowledge management looks like when agents are the primary user. The goal is alignment between people and agents: everything lives as .md files, so nothing is tied to one app and agents can work with it directly.
hero.note: knloop will keep exploring better ways to work alongside agents.

flow.label: Human
flow.title: Set the rules and constraints
flow.body:
Write down specs, SOPs, QA, retrospectives, and context.
Judgment comes from you; the rules are yours to define.

flow.label: Agent
flow.title: Agents read
flow.body:
Works natively with Claude Code / Codex and more.
Agents read and write your notes over MCP.

flow.label: Agent
flow.title: Agents do the work
flow.body:
Agents work to your specs and write their output back.
Each result becomes context for the next round.

flow.label: Git
flow.title: Git keeps the trail
flow.body:
Automatic commits and version control.
Every change is diffable, and you can roll back at any time.

local.title: Local-first, pure Markdown
local.description: Stored natively on your own disk. Files stay clean, transparent, and portable — no format or platform lock-in.

agents.title: AI-native collaboration, out of the box
agents.description: Loads common agent CLIs automatically, no configuration. Works natively with Codex, Claude Code, Pi, DeepSeek Harness and more.

mcp.title: MCP built in, so outside agents can read and write
mcp.description: Your notes are the agent's context. External agents can read and write, and their output lands back in the same vault.

git.title: Native Git, automatic commits and version control
git.description: Documents are managed like code. Every change is recorded, every commit is diffable, so you can roll back whenever you want.

editor.title: Visual block editor + Raw dual mode
editor.description: Switch seamlessly between block editing and RAW. Very large documents move into RAW mode automatically.

start.title: Low learning curve, ready from the first minute
start.description: The interaction feels natural — open it and write. Cmd+K and shortcuts are intuitive, so newcomers get productive fast.

cta.title: Explore with us.
cta.body: Install knloop, connect the agent you like, and try a better way of working.

footer.tagline: Efficient knowledge management tools for every knowledge worker and team.
